lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Budget 2026 shifts Liberal government’s language on home construction targets, Canada's National Observer reports.
Sombre Remembrance Day in Wainwright as town honours soldiers killed in military training fire, The Canadian Press reports.

Nvidia’s board of directors is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang soon, according to two sources, amid allegations Huang had an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies believe was a Chinese asset, CBS News reports.
Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom as state’s first Black US senator since Reconstruction, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
